schema:
-- The log. Two tables, both append-only (the triggers below refuse UPDATE and DELETE).
CREATE TABLE meta(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE tx(
  t        INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,   -- the transaction's entity id
  instant  TEXT NOT NULL,         -- when the log took it (also the fact [t tx/instant instant])
  prev     TEXT NOT NULL,         -- the previous transaction's hash (64 zeros before genesis)
  hash     TEXT NOT NULL          -- sha256 over prev, t and the transaction's datoms (ownpurse-facts encode.rs)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE datom(
  e      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  a      INTEGER NOT NULL,        -- the attribute's entity id; its name is in the view `attr`
  v      ANY,                     -- INTEGER for refs, ints and bools; TEXT for everything else
  vt     INTEGER NOT NULL,        -- value type tag: 1 ref 2 string 3 int 4 decimal 5 bool 6 date 7 instant 8 keyword 9 hash
  tx     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tx(t),
  added  INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (added IN (0, 1))
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX datom_eavt ON datom(e, a, tx);
CREATE INDEX datom_avet ON datom(a, v, e);
CREATE INDEX datom_tx ON datom(tx);

CREATE TRIGGER tx_append_only_u BEFORE UPDATE ON tx BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the log is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER tx_append_only_d BEFORE DELETE ON tx BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the log is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER datom_append_only_u BEFORE UPDATE ON datom BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the log is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER datom_append_only_d BEFORE DELETE ON datom BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the log is append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER meta_append_only_u BEFORE UPDATE ON meta BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'meta is written once'); END;

-- Views for reading the log by hand. Nothing below is stored; every view is a query over `datom`.

-- attribute id -> name
CREATE VIEW attr AS
  SELECT e AS id, v AS ident FROM datom WHERE a = 1 AND added = 1;

-- every datom, readable: the history. `shown` names a ref's target by its label.
CREATE VIEW history AS
  SELECT d.tx, d.e, at.ident AS attr, d.v AS value,
    CASE d.added WHEN 1 THEN 'assert' ELSE 'retract' END AS op,
    CASE d.vt WHEN 1 THEN coalesce((SELECT label FROM label WHERE e = d.v), d.v) ELSE d.v END AS shown
  FROM datom d JOIN attr at ON at.id = d.a;

-- the facts that are true now: asserted, and not retracted by a later transaction
CREATE VIEW facts AS
  SELECT d.e, at.ident AS attr, d.v AS value, d.tx, d.vt
  FROM datom d JOIN attr at ON at.id = d.a
  WHERE d.added = 1
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM datom r
                    WHERE r.e = d.e AND r.a = d.a AND r.v IS d.v AND r.added = 0 AND r.tx > d.tx);

-- one name per entity: its strongest identity (a document id before an observation id, and so on)
CREATE VIEW label AS
  SELECT e, label FROM (
    SELECT f.e, f.value AS label, min(CASE f.attr
      WHEN 'doc/id' THEN 1 WHEN 'obs/id' THEN 2 WHEN 'entry/id' THEN 3 WHEN 'posting/id' THEN 4
      WHEN 'account/id' THEN 5 WHEN 'party/id' THEN 6 WHEN 'commodity/code' THEN 7 WHEN 'source/id' THEN 8
      WHEN 'book/id' THEN 9 WHEN 'link/id' THEN 10 WHEN 'region/id' THEN 11 WHEN 'file/sha256' THEN 12
      WHEN 'db/ident' THEN 13 END) AS rank
    FROM facts f
    WHERE f.attr IN ('doc/id', 'obs/id', 'entry/id', 'posting/id', 'account/id', 'party/id', 'commodity/code',
                     'source/id', 'book/id', 'link/id', 'region/id', 'file/sha256', 'db/ident')
    GROUP BY f.e);

-- the facts that are true now, with refs named
CREATE VIEW facts_shown AS
  SELECT f.e, (SELECT label FROM label WHERE e = f.e) AS entity, f.attr,
    CASE f.vt WHEN 1 THEN coalesce((SELECT label FROM label WHERE e = f.value), f.value) ELSE f.value END AS value,
    f.tx
  FROM facts f;

-- one row per transaction, with who, why and from what
CREATE VIEW transactions AS
  SELECT t.t AS tx, t.instant,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = t.t AND attr = 'tx/actor') AS actor,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = t.t AND attr = 'tx/projector') AS projector,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = t.t AND attr = 'tx/reason') AS reason,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM facts WHERE e = t.t AND attr = 'tx/evidence') AS files,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM datom WHERE tx = t.t AND added = 1) AS asserted,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM datom WHERE tx = t.t AND added = 0) AS retracted
  FROM tx t;

-- the drawer: every file the log knows, and whether its bytes were redacted
CREATE VIEW files AS
  SELECT f.e,
    f.value AS sha256,
    (SELECT group_concat(value, ' | ') FROM facts WHERE e = f.e AND attr = 'file/name') AS names,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = f.e AND attr = 'file/media-type') AS media_type,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = f.e AND attr = 'file/size') AS size,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = f.e AND attr = 'file/redacted') AS redacted
  FROM facts f WHERE f.attr = 'file/sha256';

-- observations with their shared attributes, the account and commodity resolved to names
CREATE VIEW observations AS
  SELECT o.e,
    o.value AS id,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'obs/kind' THEN f.value END) AS kind,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'obs/date' THEN f.value END) AS date,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'obs/amount' THEN f.value END) AS amount,
    (SELECT c.value FROM facts r JOIN facts c ON c.e = r.value AND c.attr = 'commodity/code'
      WHERE r.e = o.e AND r.attr = 'obs/commodity') AS commodity,
    (SELECT n.value FROM facts r JOIN facts n ON n.e = r.value AND n.attr = 'account/name'
      WHERE r.e = o.e AND r.attr = 'obs/account') AS account,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'obs/counterparty' THEN f.value END) AS counterparty,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'obs/description' THEN f.value END) AS description,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'obs/confidence' THEN f.value END) AS confidence,
    (SELECT p.value FROM facts r JOIN facts p ON p.e = r.value AND p.attr = 'obs/id'
      WHERE r.e = o.e AND r.attr = 'obs/parent') AS parent,
    (SELECT d.value FROM facts r JOIN facts d ON d.e = r.value AND d.attr = 'doc/id'
      WHERE r.e = o.e AND r.attr = 'obs/doc') AS doc
  FROM facts o JOIN facts f ON f.e = o.e
  WHERE o.attr = 'obs/id'
  GROUP BY o.e;

-- links between any two entities, each end shown by its identity
CREATE VIEW links AS
  SELECT l.e,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'link/kind' THEN f.value END) AS kind,
    (SELECT lb.label FROM facts r JOIN label lb ON lb.e = r.value
      WHERE r.e = l.e AND r.attr = 'link/from') AS from_id,
    (SELECT lb.label FROM facts r JOIN label lb ON lb.e = r.value
      WHERE r.e = l.e AND r.attr = 'link/to') AS to_id,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'link/confidence' THEN f.value END) AS confidence,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'link/amount' THEN f.value END) AS amount,
    max(CASE WHEN f.attr = 'link/rule' THEN f.value END) AS rule
  FROM facts l JOIN facts f ON f.e = l.e
  WHERE l.attr = 'link/id'
  GROUP BY l.e;

-- postings with their entry, account and commodity
CREATE VIEW postings AS
  SELECT en.value AS entry,
    (SELECT b.value FROM facts r JOIN facts b ON b.e = r.value AND b.attr = 'book/id'
      WHERE r.e = en.e AND r.attr = 'entry/book') AS book,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = en.e AND attr = 'entry/date') AS date,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = en.e AND attr = 'entry/status') AS status,
    (SELECT n.value FROM facts r JOIN facts n ON n.e = r.value AND n.attr = 'account/name'
      WHERE r.e = p.value AND r.attr = 'posting/account') AS account,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = p.value AND attr = 'posting/quantity') AS quantity,
    (SELECT c.value FROM facts r JOIN facts c ON c.e = r.value AND c.attr = 'commodity/code'
      WHERE r.e = p.value AND r.attr = 'posting/commodity') AS commodity,
    (SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = p.value AND attr = 'posting/memo') AS memo
  FROM facts en
  JOIN facts p ON p.e = en.e AND p.attr = 'entry/posting'
  WHERE en.attr = 'entry/id';

queries.sql:
-- Every transaction in the log: who wrote it, with which projector, from how many files, and what it changed.
SELECT tx, instant, actor, projector, files, asserted, retracted
FROM transactions
ORDER BY tx;

-- Every top-level observation, in date order: what each source said happened.
SELECT kind, date, amount, commodity, account, counterparty, doc
FROM observations
WHERE parent IS NULL
ORDER BY date, kind;

-- The dinner's bank transaction in Xero, every fact ever asserted or retracted about it, with when and by whom.
-- The reference arrives in the second pull; nothing is overwritten.
SELECT h.tx, t.instant, h.op, h.attr, h.shown AS value, t.actor
FROM history h
JOIN transactions t ON t.tx = h.tx
WHERE h.e = (SELECT e FROM facts WHERE attr = 'doc/id'
             AND value = 'xero:tallowmere/BankTransaction/c0ffee05-0000-4000-8000-000000000003')
  AND h.attr NOT LIKE 'xero.%'
ORDER BY h.tx, h.op DESC, h.attr;

-- Each mirrored book's balances by account, summed exactly. The log holds more than one company's books (the
-- roastery's Xero, Quillfeather's QuickBooks), so a trial balance is always per book. dsum() is registered by
-- `ownpurse-facts sql`; SQLite's own sum() would turn the decimal text into floating point.
SELECT book, account, dsum(quantity) AS balance, count(*) AS postings
FROM postings
WHERE status = 'entry.status/posted'
GROUP BY book, account
ORDER BY book, account;

-- Time travel in plain SQL: INV-0415's facts as the log knew them right after the last transaction read before the
-- second Xero pull (observed 2026-04-02). A fact is true at T if it was asserted at or before T and not retracted
-- at or before T. `--as-of T` does the same for every command.
WITH t(at) AS (SELECT max(e) FROM facts WHERE attr = 'tx/observed-at' AND value < '2026-04-02')
SELECT d.attr, d.value, d.tx
FROM history d, t
WHERE d.e = (SELECT e FROM facts WHERE attr = 'obs/reference' AND value = 'INV-0415')
  AND d.op = 'assert' AND d.tx <= t.at
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM history r
                  WHERE r.e = d.e AND r.attr = d.attr AND r.value IS d.value
                    AND r.op = 'retract' AND r.tx > d.tx AND r.tx <= t.at)
  AND d.attr IN ('obs/amount', 'obs/status', 'xero.Invoice/Total', 'xero.Invoice/UpdatedDateUTC')
ORDER BY d.attr;

-- From a posting in the books back to the file it came from: posting → entry → the document it mirrors →
-- every file that carried a version of that document.
SELECT p.entry, p.account, p.quantity, l.kind AS link, f.names AS file, f.sha256
FROM postings p
JOIN facts en ON en.attr = 'entry/id' AND en.value = p.entry
JOIN links l ON l.from_id = p.entry
JOIN facts dd ON dd.attr = 'doc/id' AND dd.value = l.to_id
JOIN facts df ON df.e = dd.e AND df.attr = 'doc/file'
JOIN files f ON f.e = df.value
WHERE p.account = 'Meals and entertainment'
ORDER BY p.entry, f.names;

-- Where the sources did not fit the model, as the projectors reported it (also: `ownpurse-facts pressure`).
SELECT substr(value, 1, instr(value, ' | ') - 1) AS kind, count(*) AS times, min(value) AS example
FROM facts
WHERE attr = 'tx/pressure'
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY times DESC;

-- The schema is facts too: attributes by namespace, and the transaction that installed each group.
SELECT substr(a.ident, 1, instr(a.ident, '/') - 1) AS namespace, count(*) AS attributes, min(d.tx) AS first_tx
FROM attr a
JOIN datom d ON d.e = a.id AND d.a = 1
GROUP BY namespace
ORDER BY first_tx, namespace;

-- Everything that backs the 186.40 dinner in the books, from every source: the posting's entry mirrors Xero's
-- bank transaction; the link rules joined it to the bank's CSV line, OFX line and statement line (same-event)
-- and to the receipt photo (evidences). Each witness is shown with the file it came from and where in it.
WITH RECURSIVE
  start(e) AS (SELECT e FROM facts WHERE attr = 'doc/id'
               AND value = 'xero:tallowmere/BankTransaction/c0ffee05-0000-4000-8000-000000000003'),
  ends(a, b) AS (
    SELECT f.value, t.value FROM facts l
      JOIN facts f ON f.e = l.e AND f.attr = 'link/from'
      JOIN facts t ON t.e = l.e AND t.attr = 'link/to'
     WHERE l.attr = 'link/kind' AND l.value IN ('link.kind/same-event', 'link.kind/evidences')),
  witness(e) AS (
    SELECT e FROM start
    UNION SELECT b FROM ends JOIN witness ON a = witness.e
    UNION SELECT a FROM ends JOIN witness ON b = witness.e)
SELECT o.kind, o.date, o.amount, src.value AS source,
  (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT fl.names) FROM facts r JOIN facts rf ON rf.e = r.value AND rf.attr = 'region/file'
     JOIN files fl ON fl.e = rf.value WHERE r.e = w.e AND r.attr = 'obs/region') AS file,
  (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT lc.value) FROM facts r JOIN facts lc ON lc.e = r.value AND lc.attr = 'region/locator'
     WHERE r.e = w.e AND r.attr = 'obs/region') AS place
FROM witness w
JOIN observations o ON o.e = w.e
LEFT JOIN facts ds ON ds.e = coalesce((SELECT value FROM facts WHERE e = w.e AND attr = 'obs/doc'), w.e)
  AND ds.attr = 'doc/source'
LEFT JOIN facts src ON src.e = ds.value AND src.attr = 'source/id'
ORDER BY o.kind, source;

-- One invoice, two books: the supplier's invoice (QuickBooks, FreshBooks) and the roastery's bill (Xero),
-- joined by the counterpart rule. Opposite amounts, the same digits in the reference.
SELECT a.id AS issued, a.amount, a.date, b.id AS received, b.amount, b.date, l.confidence
FROM links l
JOIN observations a ON a.id = l.from_id
JOIN observations b ON b.id = l.to_id
WHERE l.kind = 'link.kind/counterpart';

-- A check, not a fact: the statement states an opening and a closing balance; every stream of bank lines for the
-- same account (the CSV downloads, OFX, the statement's own lines) must carry the opening to the closing. A pending
-- line that lapsed is not money that moved. `difference` is exact (dsum) and should be 0.
WITH bal AS (
  SELECT f.value AS account, o.date, o.amount
  FROM observations o JOIN facts f ON f.e = o.e AND f.attr = 'obs/account'
  WHERE o.kind = 'obs.kind/balance'),
period AS (
  SELECT account, min(date) AS start, max(date) AS finish,
    (SELECT amount FROM bal b WHERE b.account = p.account ORDER BY date LIMIT 1) AS opening,
    (SELECT amount FROM bal b WHERE b.account = p.account ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) AS closing
  FROM bal p GROUP BY account),
moves AS (
  SELECT f.value AS account, o.date, o.amount, t.projector
  FROM observations o
  JOIN facts f ON f.e = o.e AND f.attr = 'obs/account'
  JOIN history h ON h.e = o.e AND h.attr = 'obs/kind' AND h.op = 'assert'
  JOIN transactions t ON t.tx = h.tx
  WHERE o.kind = 'obs.kind/money-movement'
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM facts s WHERE s.e = o.e AND s.attr = 'obs/status'
                    AND s.value = 'obs.status/lapsed'))
SELECT m.projector, p.opening, dsum(m.amount) AS moved, p.closing, count(*) AS lines,
  (SELECT dsum(x) FROM (SELECT p.opening AS x UNION ALL SELECT amount FROM moves m2
     WHERE m2.account = p.account AND m2.projector = m.projector AND m2.date BETWEEN p.start AND p.finish
     UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN p.closing LIKE '-%' THEN substr(p.closing, 2)
                                   ELSE '-' || p.closing END)) AS difference
FROM period p JOIN moves m ON m.account = p.account AND m.date BETWEEN p.start AND p.finish
GROUP BY m.projector
ORDER BY m.projector;

-- A check: every posted entry in every mirrored book sums to zero, per commodity. Any row here is an entry that
-- does not balance; an empty result is a pass.
SELECT book, entry, commodity, dsum(quantity) AS off_by, count(*) AS postings
FROM postings
WHERE status = 'entry.status/posted'
GROUP BY book, entry, commodity
HAVING dsum(quantity) + 0 <> 0
ORDER BY book, entry;
